# Retail CoD United Offensive 1.51b dedicated server log lines under the --save-turret client of
# mp_carentan-dm-turret-hitwho-uo.txt beside this file. Captured 2026-11-14.
# The -hitfine-uo recipe with probe_hitwho 1 as well: every hit logs the
# damage callback's inflictor and attacker. map mp_carentan, g_gametype
# probe_turret, probe_teleport 1, probe_hitlog 1, probe_hitwho 1, dedicated 1,
# sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, a homepath holding no pak. Client 0 is a
# --probe-team axis --probe-fall net-probe standing as the target, client 1
# the --save-turret gunner, all three inside one `unshare -rn`.
#
#   COD_VERSION=uo COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> PORT=29020 PROBE_SECS=230 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_turret mp_carentan +set probe_teleport 1 +set probe_hitlog 1 +set probe_hitwho 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <UO install> --mod-dir uo --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29020 --probe-team axis --probe-fall --probe-secs 200
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --game-dir <UO install> --mod-dir uo --net-probe 127.0.0.1:29020 --save-turret --capture-tag hitwho-uo --probe-secs 190
# The axis client started 10 s after the server and the gunner 5 s after it.
#

# each <number>:<classname>.
